messages.subject: int_step function
parts:
I think I forgot to send this a few days ago:

Stan is strongly typed, so you can't use a floating
point value where an integer is required, as in
array indexes or bounds for integer parameters or
vector dimensions.

To deal with the BUGS leuk and leukfr models,
I added a function to stan::maths:

unsigned int int_step(double);

It's the integer return variant of
step(double), which returns a double.

I modified the BUGS examples leuk and leukfr
to use it.

I defined it in src/stan/maths/special_functions.hpp
and added a corresponding test set.

- Bob
